biological.citation: Splicing Factor SRSF1 Promotes Pancreatitis and KRASG12D-Mediated Pancreatic Cancer (PMID: 37098965)
biological.summary: SRSF1 is highly expressed in pancreatitis, PDAC precursor lesions, and tumors. Increased SRSF1 is sufficient to induce pancreatitis and accelerate KRASG12D-mediated PDAC by activating MAPK signaling partly through alternative-splicing-regulated upregulation of IL1R1. A negative feedback mechanism destabilizes SRSF1 protein in normal epithelial cells expressing KRASG12D, which is overcome by hyperactive MYC to facilitate tumorigenesis.

biological.citation: Endothelial SRSF1 Promotes Ischemia-Induced Angiogenesis via ATF3-KLF2-S1PR1 Pathway (PMID: 41195527)
biological.summary: SRSF1 expression is elevated in endothelial cells after ischemia and hypoxia. SRSF1 modulates alternative splicing of ATF3 pre-mRNA by direct binding, promoting full-length ATF3 over truncated ATF3Δzip2, which suppresses KLF2 and downstream S1PR1 signaling to enhance angiogenesis. Endothelial-specific SRSF1 knockout mice showed impaired blood flow recovery after hindlimb ischemia, while SRSF1 overexpression enhanced angiogenesis in vivo and in vitro.

biological.citation: Targeting SRSF1 improves cancer immunotherapy by dually acting on CD8(+)T and tumor cells (PMID: 39837814)
biological.summary: Depleting SRSF1 in CD8+ T cells improves antitumor immune function and glycolytic metabolism, enhancing adoptive T cell therapy efficacy. SRSF1 inactivation in tumor cells reduces transcription factors c-Jun, c-myc, and JunB, reprogramming glycolytic metabolism and restoring CD8+ T cell function. A small-molecule inhibitor TN2008 targeting SRSF1 boosted antitumor immune responses in mouse models.

biological.citation: FAM120A couples SREBP-dependent transcription and splicing of lipogenesis enzymes downstream of mTORC1 (PMID: 37595559)
biological.summary: mTORC1-activated SRPK2 phosphorylates SRSF1, enhancing its binding to FAM120A, which bridges newly transcribed lipogenic genes from RNA polymerase II to the SRSF1 and U1-70K-containing RNA-splicing machinery. This multi-protein complex promotes efficient splicing and stability of lipogenic transcripts, resulting in fatty acid synthesis and cancer cell proliferation. SRSF1 thus functions as a downstream effector of mTORC1-SRPK2 signaling in anabolic cell growth.

biological.citation: Genomic Landscape Survey Identifies SRSF1 as a Key Oncodriver in Small Cell Lung Cancer (PMID: 27093186)
biological.summary: SRSF1 DNA copy number gain and mRNA over-expression were strongly associated with poor survival in SCLC patients across discovery and validation cohorts of 99 Chinese patients. Functional studies in vitro and in vivo demonstrated that SRSF1 is important for tumorigenicity of SCLC and may play a key role in DNA repair and chemo-sensitivity. These results support SRSF1 as a prognostic biomarker in SCLC.

biological.citation: SRSF1 Is Crucial for Maintaining Satellite Cell Homeostasis During Skeletal Muscle Growth and Regeneration (PMID: 39381961)
biological.summary: SRSF1 knockout in satellite cells (via MyoD-Cre) caused early mortality and muscle atrophy in mice, with scRNA-seq revealing increased activated/proliferating myoblasts (28.68% to 77.06%) that underwent mitotic abnormalities, cell cycle arrest, and cellular senescence. SRSF1 regulates splicing of Fgfr1op2 to favor the full-length isoform crucial for mitotic spindle organization; its loss causes multipolar spindle formation. Adult satellite cells lacking SRSF1 fail to regenerate muscle after cardiotoxin injury due to impaired proliferation.

biological.citation: Unearthing a novel function of SRSF1 in binding and unfolding of RNA G-quadruplexes (PMID: 38567732)
biological.summary: SRSF1 was found to bind RNA G-quadruplexes (GQ) from ARPC2 mRNA using both its RRM domains and RS domain, with the RS domain preferring purine over pyrimidine. FRET and circular dichroism data revealed that SRSF1 unfolds the ARPC2 GQ, with RS leading unfolding and RRMs aiding, through Arg residues interacting specifically with guanine bases. Luciferase assays confirmed that SRSF1 alleviates the inhibitory effect of GQ on gene expression in cells, revealing a novel function beyond canonical splicing enhancer recognition.

biological.citation: ASHG 2022 - SRSF1 haploinsufficiency is responsible for a syndromic developmental disorder with intellectual disability and variable marfanoid habitus
biological.summary: Sixteen patients with germline SRSF1 variants (frameshift, nonsense, missense, and microdeletion of 17q22) presented with developmental delay, intellectual disability, hypotonia, behavioral disorders, and skeletal/cardiac anomalies. Eye-specific overexpression of SF2 (the Drosophila ortholog of SRSF1) induced a severe developmental phenotype due to missplicing of key genes involved in eye development, and overexpression of human SRSF1 phenocopied this, demonstrating functional conservation. In vivo splicing assays in Drosophila supported pathogenicity of the identified variants.

biological.citation: FOXA1 regulates alternative splicing in prostate cancer (PMID: 36170835)
biological.summary: FOXA1 binds to the regulatory regions of splicing-related genes including SRSF1, controlling its expression as part of a cascade that rewires alternative splicing in prostate cancer across 500 primary and metastatic transcriptomes. FOXA1-controlled oncogene SRSF1 promotes inclusion of the NMD-determinant FLNA exon 30, which promotes cell growth in vitro and predicts disease recurrence. SRSF1 is thus positioned downstream of FOXA1 in a chromatin-to-splicing regulatory cascade.

SRSF1 was found to stimulate SUMO conjugation to several spliceosomal proteins during active splicing reactions. SUMOylation of spliceosomal components, modulated by SRSF1, is proposed to regulate spliceosome assembly and splicing efficiency. This identifies SRSF1 as a regulator of post-translational modification of the splicing machinery beyond its direct RNA-binding role.
